method: Continuous source decode -> existing public_tile_detector top_group -> existing meld geometry normalization/split -> source-reviewed opponent public-meld regions -> MeldSnapshotObserver(settle_frames=3). Geometry-only static reviewed group boxes; no identity labels supplied.
identity_review: Normalized crop inspected; source resolution does not justify assigning complete automatic tile identities. User-verified P7 remains benchmark truth only.
negative_control: Transient STACKED classification during the CHI animation cannot establish KONG. The normalization produced no flat faces there; snapshots were untrusted, and disappearance after the transient appearance was also untrusted. The existing right-side group persisted.
scope_boundary: No action classifier output, no corroborated CHI promotion, no claimed new rule. Optical counts and meld geometry are same-source development. Reviewed river labels were not supplied to the meld detector.
private_reproducibility: Full frames, decoded hashes, reviewed ROIs and full per-frame trace remain private. Fresh-checkout reproduction requires exact source and reviewed private regions.
next_step: Recover source-qualified complete public-meld identity and independent hand-change evidence before promoting this temporal alignment to CHI; keep river-removal context separate from DISCARD.
